property_summary: For any callee whose transferFrom succeeds, C.transfer completes successfully (returns true), while the bug reverts because it requires the failed-call flag; if the callee fails, C reverts and the bug completes. Thus C's success/revert outcome is the opposite of the mutant's for any nonzero-length list.
change_summary: Replace require(_s) with require(!_s) so successful external calls now cause a revert and failed calls proceed.
